description: This PHP file defines search configurations ('searchdefs') for the 'AM_ProjectTemplates' module in a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM environment. It sets up layout structures for basic and advanced searches, including field configurations and search-related metadata.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: A function referenced in the searchdefs array to generate an array of users, used for populating a dropdown in the search layout.
